answer: Deposits are visible in tide, and grove reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 44 aliases, and each one needs its own funded spiral account. A bond of 50% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Scaling to 518 identities multiplies that fee by 530 with no matching gain in influence. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
